assertion_reviews.finding: The book prints no EO number. September20,1906 date, Roosevelt signature, subject and sole operative body agree with the two permitted IC1911 crosswalk rows identifying EO:506, contents entry44/WPA M54. Parent April1,1905 is qualified as EO:317A by the same crosswalks. No number is inferred from the printed page itself. Original-representation metadata header is provenance, not operative text.

One operative paragraph permits a specified quarterly session at the Governor office on the Isthmus on November15,1906 instead of October1. The genuine offsets1081-1407 contain that complete paragraph. No appointment, report, implementation deadline, recurring new quarterly schedule, independent duty or attachment appears. Parent committee meetings, powers, appointments, contracts, accounts and reports remain distinct parent commands.

September20 is issuance; no delayed-effect clause appears. October1 is the displaced date, not exhaustion. November15 is included in the permission. Close of November15 / November16 00:00 is a defensible boundary for fresh date-specific commencement permission, derived from the named date rather than an express sunset clause. There is no literal until clause and no implementation grace period.

Parent printed33 separately authorizes continuation as public business requires. A session lawfully commenced on November15 could continue after midnight. No meeting, quorum, exercise, adjournment, actual duration, completion or nonperformance is proved. Genuine whole_order_end and terminated fields are supportable only in the expressly bounded fresh-permission sense; they must not be consumed as actual adjournment or extinction of all resulting legal effects.

The original and complete parent establish no earlier exhaustion. The genuine card asserts a bounded local session-search.json found no intervening pre-November15 change; that artifact is not supplied or examined. Prior sealed review describes only nearby OCR leads and expressly disclaims exhaustive search. Neither that prior finding nor zero number hits independently closes earlier cancellation, amendment or other legal intervention. USC search is only through2026-10-09, leaving October10-14 outside that edition; eCFR covers49titles and OFR catalog begins1937 with17521 saved order texts. These are limited number-citation searches, not proof of all unnamed legal changes.

No express savings clause or independent continuing EO:506 command appears in the complete original. Historical validity and consequences of a lawfully commenced session, and parent-governed continuation, are not fresh permission to choose a later commencement date. Parent printed36 preserves consistent prior Panama Canal orders; that parent clause does not supply a new EO:506 command or establish absence of later rights. The card's none_after_bounded_search must retain the actual search limitation.
